## Generate Occupation Categories

```{r}
# Generate occupational categories natively on the server side
acs_occ_labeled <- data_acs %>%
  filter(HISPAN == 2 | HISPAND == 200 | ANCESTR1 == 261, AGE >= 16, EMPSTAT == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    occ_cat1 = case_when(
      (occ2010 >= 10 & occ2010 <= 960) | (occ2010 >= 2600 & occ2010 <= 2960) ~ "1. Management, Business, Entertainment & Media",
      occ2010 >= 1000 & occ2010 <= 1965 ~ "2. STEM",
      (occ2010 >= 2000 & occ2010 <= 2550) | (occ2010 >= 4300 & occ2010 <= 4650) ~ "3. Education, Community & Social Services",
      occ2010 >= 3000 & occ2010 <= 3655 ~ "4. Health & Medical",
      (occ2010 >= 3700 & occ2010 <= 3955) | (occ2010 >= 9000 & occ2010 <= 9420) ~ "5. Law Enforcement & Transportation",
      occ2010 >= 4000 & occ2010 <= 4250 ~ "6. Food, Maintenance, Building & Grounds Cleaning",
      occ2010 >= 4700 & occ2010 <= 4965 ~ "7. Sales and Related",
      occ2010 >= 5000 & occ2010 <= 5940 ~ "8. Administrative and Office Support",
      occ2010 >= 6005 & occ2010 <= 7630 ~ "9. Natural Resources, Construction & Maintenance",
      (occ2010 >= 7700 & occ2010 <= 8965) | (occ2010 >= 9500 & occ2010 <= 9750) ~ "10. Production and Material Moving",
      occ2010 >= 9800 & occ2010 <= 9830 ~ "11. Military",
      occ2010 %in% c(9920, 9999) ~ "12. Unclassified",
      TRUE ~ "12. Unclassified"
    )
  )
```

## Calculate workers per categories

```{r occ_cat1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
occ_cat1 <- acs_occ_labeled %>%
  group_by(YEAR, occ_cat1) %>%
  summarise(workers = sum(PERWT, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  collect() %>%
  group_by(YEAR) %>%
  mutate(pct_workers = workers / sum(workers) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r Arrange Levels, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
occ_levels <- c(
  "1. Management, Business, Entertainment & Media",
  "2. STEM",
  "3. Education, Community & Social Services",
  "4. Health and Medical",
  "5. Law Enforcement & Transportation",
  "6. Food, Maintenance, Building & Grounds Cleaning",
  "7. Sales and Related",
  "8. Administrative and Office Support",
  "9. Natural Resources, Construction & Maintenance",
  "10. Production and Material Moving",
  "11. Military",
  "12. Unclassified"
)

occ_cat1 <- occ_cat1 %>%
  mutate(
    occ_cat1 = factor(
      occ_cat1,
      levels = occ_levels,
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```


## Occupation Visualization

```{r plot worker, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Using facet_wrap to prevent the spaghetti chart effect of 12 intersecting lines
ggplot(occ_cat1, aes(x = YEAR, y = workers, color = occ_cat1)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ occ_cat1, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  important_years_lines +
  my_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + # Legend isn't needed with facets
  labs(
    title = "Puerto Rican Workers by Occupation",
    subtitle = "Estimated workers over time. Note: Y-axis scales vary by panel.",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Workers"
  )
```


```{r plot pct_worker, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Using facet_wrap to prevent the spaghetti chart effect of 12 intersecting lines
ggplot(occ_cat1, aes(x = YEAR, y = pct_workers, color = occ_cat1)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ occ_cat1, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  important_years_lines +
  my_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none") + # Legend isn't needed with facets
  labs(
    title = "Puerto Rican Workers by Occupation",
    subtitle = "Percent workers over time. Note: Y-axis scales vary by panel.",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Workers"
  )
```

```{r change workers, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
occ_change <- occ_cat1 %>%
  group_by(occ_cat1) %>%
  arrange(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    first_share = first(pct_workers),
    last_share = last(pct_workers),
    pp_change = last_share - first_share,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pp_change))


occ_change
```


```{r plot change, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(occ_change, aes(x = reorder(occ_cat1, pp_change), y = pp_change, fill = pp_change > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  my_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#d95f02", "TRUE" = "#1b9e77")) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Occupational Composition",
    subtitle = "Percentage-point change between first and last year",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage Point Change"
  )
```
